record.question: She cannot manage the situation. Select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive Voice:
options: The situation cannot be managed by her.
The situation could not be managed by her.
The situation will not be managed by her.
Managing the situation is not possible by her.
record.explanation: Retain cannot and use the passive structure be managed. The situation cannot be managed by her is the matching modal passive. Reviewed solution (unofficial). References: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/free-resources/grammar/english-grammar-reference/active-passive-voice
